reactions.label: photosystem I
reactions.boundary: The source reaction uses protein-bound carriers and light. The SMILES projection preserves reactive metal parts only; it is not evidence that free copper ions replace plastocyanin or that light can be omitted.

reactions.label: photosystem II, exact plastoquinone-9 form
reactions.boundary: The exact source form consumes two plastoquinone-9 and two water molecules, with four photons, and yields two plastoquinol-9 and oxygen. Element/charge balance in the molecular projection does not establish energetics, light availability or physiological reversibility.

claim_boundary: Source-linked annotations only; no reaction, direction, exchange boundary or coverage changes. Photons are energy inputs, not wildcard chemical atoms or carbon-free mineral nutrients. Enforcing light availability and energy direction remains outstanding. Other photochemical and energy-coupled reactions have not yet been exhaustively annotated.
